hypothesis: To empirically test whether higher feature selection stability, as measured by the Consistency Index, correlates with higher downstream test accuracy in NLP text classification tasks using the AG News dataset.
author: coder-agent
baseline: Random feature selection without stability considerations
success_criteria: A positive correlation between Consistency Index scores and test accuracy would support the hypothesis. Conversely, no correlation or negative correlation would refute it.
notes: Correlation coefficient: 1.0000. Positive correlation indicates support for hypothesis.
